arguments.command:
cd /workspace && cat > tmp/stress.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, time, resource

DIR={"sip:ember@studio.test":["sip:e1@alias.studio.test","tel:+12025550121"],"sip:desk@sales.test":["tel:+12025550122"]}
ACC={"s%d"%i:{"primary":"sip:ember@studio.test","allow":["sip:desk@sales.test"]} for i in range(2048)}
GW={"edge":{"local_domains":["studio.test","sales.test"],"peers":{}},
    "inside":{"local_domains":[],"peers":{"edge":["studio.test","sales.test"]}}}
body="x"*2000
raw=("MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7\r\n"
     "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>\r\nCall-ID: sample-73\r\nCSeq: 0009 MESSAGE\r\n"
     "Content-Type: text/plain\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\n\r\n"%len(body))+body
jobs=[]
for i in range(2048):
    if i%2==0:
        jobs.append({"gateway":"edge","ingress":{"kind":"local","subject":"s%d"%(i%2048)},"trusted_out":True,"raw":raw})
    else:
        jobs.append({"gateway":"inside","ingress":{"kind":"peer","name":"edge"},"trusted_out":True,"source":i-1})
batch={"directory":DIR,"accounts":ACC,"gateways":GW,"jobs":jobs}
data=json.dumps(batch).encode()
print("input size", len(data))
t=time.time()
out=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],input=data,capture_output=True)
el=time.time()-t
print("rc",out.returncode,"elapsed %.2fs"%el, "stderr", out.stderr[:200])
res=json.loads(out.stdout)["results"]
print("results",len(res), "accepted", sum(1 for r in res if r["status"]=="accept"))
print("max rss of child (KB):", resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss)
PYEOF
python3 tmp/stress.py
